answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring every new identity to stake a non-transferable bond of compute-verified work equal to 30 minutes of high-quality inference on a public model, checked via a zero-knowledge proof of the exact token count and latency. Attackers cannot cheaply spin up thousands of accounts because each must burn real GPU cycles whose cost rises with demand; a knoll of colluding agents still pays the full price, while a zephyr of honest participants can audit the proofs on the atlas of public benchmarks.
